name: What are the benefits of building an ADU on my property?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an ADU offers several benefits for homeowners. It can provide additional income through rental opportunities, house aging parents or adult children, or serve as a dedicated home office or guest suite. ADUs can also increase property value and help address housing shortages in many areas. They offer flexibility in how space is used and can adapt to changing family needs over time without requiring a new home purchase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include rental income, housing for family, increased property value, and flexible living space.
